run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend-proxy since 2026-11-15T05:22:57Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert for otel-demo/frontend-proxy (0.0111 at 05:22:57Z) is backed by real 5xx responses recorded on frontend-proxy itself: its ingress spans carry STATUS_CODE_ERROR (7.2218 spans in the hour to 05:22:57Z against 14538.54 UNSET), and the proxy access log shows two distinct 5xx signatures. (1) Sporadic 503 UC upstream_reset_before_response_started{connection_termination} against its upstream cluster 'frontend' on GET routes, present from the earliest sampled error traces (05:02:20Z-05:10:44Z) through 05:33:42Z, i.e. already present at the alert instant. (2) A dense burst of 500 via_upstream on POST /api/checkout between 05:24Z and 05:30Z that traces frontend POST /api/checkout -> checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder -> checkout client span oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge, to the Deployment/payment rolling update at 05:23:10Z (old pod stopped 05:23:15Z; new container only logged 'payment gRPC server started on port 8080' at 05:24:31Z). No pod crash, OOM, eviction, restart or node pressure was observed. The deepest cause of the frontend connection resets is unconfirmed because the frontend container produced no readable logs, and the alert's exact expression and denominator are unknown because no alerting rule or http_* metric is available in this source.

claims.text: At the alert instant frontend-proxy's own spans are erroring: sum by (status_code) of increase(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="frontend-proxy",span_name="ingress"}[1h]) at 05:22:57Z is 7.2218 for STATUS_CODE_ERROR versus 14538.54 for STATUS_CODE_UNSET, while 'router frontend egress' STATUS_CODE_ERROR is 0 and its UNSET is 14545.76.

In the hour ending 05:22:57Z only frontend-proxy (7.2218) plus ad (1.0451), recommendation (2.0627) and fraud-detection (1.0394) returned non-zero STATUS_CODE_ERROR series; frontend, payment, accounting and cart returned 0 error spans and no checkout error series was returned.

The earliest sampled frontend-proxy error traces (spans starting 05:02:20Z-05:10:44Z) are ingress spans with error=true, http.status_code=503 and otel.status_code=ERROR; each has a child 'router frontend egress' span carrying error="true" and http.status_code=0, and trace a72b1518a1c4b0b8d3e417b7c02a95ef contains no frontend span at all.

The frontend-proxy access log records 503 UC 'upstream_reset_before_response_started{connection_termination}' against the upstream cluster named 'frontend' on GET paths: 05:24:07.832Z GET /api/products/OLJCESPC7Z, 05:26:01.297Z and 05:26:01.421Z GET /api/data, 05:27:44.361Z GET /api/data, and 05:33:42.761Z GET /api/recommendations?productIds=OLJCESPC7Z (upstream duration 753 ms).

Deployment/payment was rolled at 05:23:10Z: ReplicaSet payment-79d86bf97f was created 05:23:10Z with image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-payment, the previous ReplicaSet payment-55766d76b9 (same image string, created 04:51:15Z) was scaled to 0 replicas, and events show 'Scaled up replica set payment-79d86bf97f from 0 to 1' at 05:23:10Z, container Started at 05:23:14Z, and old pod payment-55766d76b9-5frt4 'Stopping container payment' / SuccessfulDelete at 05:23:15Z.

The new payment container logged 'payment gRPC server started on port 8080' only at 05:24:31.791Z, about 76 s after the old payment pod was stopped at 05:23:15Z, and logged '14 UNAVAILABLE: Connection dropped' at 05:25:27.851Z.

checkout's spans oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder and oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge and payment's server span grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge record 78 STATUS_CODE_ERROR spans in the one-minute bucket ending 05:26:00Z and 2 in the bucket ending 05:27:00Z, with 0 in every other minute bucket from 05:14Z to 05:40Z.

In the 20 minutes to 05:36:57Z frontend's error spans are confined to the checkout path: POST /api/checkout 82.82, executing api route (pages) /api/checkout 82.82 and grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder 82.82; frontend-proxy shows ingress 91.00 and router frontend egress 82.82; checkout shows oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge 42.11 and oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder 42.11. These are span counts, not unique request counts.

The proxy logged 'POST /api/checkout HTTP/1.1" 500 - via_upstream' at 05:23:52.477Z, inside the interval between the old payment pod being stopped (05:23:15Z) and the new payment gRPC server starting (05:24:31Z).

frontend-proxy ingress error spans rise from 7.2218 (hour to 05:22:57Z) to 179.03 (hour to 05:36:57Z) and frontend from 0 to 329.59; over the same hours payment, accounting and cart return 0 error spans.

The error pattern has two parts: per-minute frontend-proxy ingress error spans were 0 in the buckets ending 05:18Z-05:22Z, then 2 (05:23Z), 2 (05:24Z) and 74 (05:26Z); broader 4-minute buckets show a steady low rate of about 1-3 error spans from 05:04Z to 05:22Z, peaks of 51.43 / 96 / 46.86 at 05:24:57Z / 05:26:57Z / 05:28:57Z, then 1.14 at 05:30:57Z and 05:34:57Z and 3.53 at 05:36:57Z.

Kubernetes state at query time: all 21 otel-demo pods are Running and Ready with 0 restarts; the frontend container has run since 04:51:17Z with an empty lastState, frontend pod IP 100.96.3.9, load-generator 100.96.3.209, frontend-proxy 100.96.2.36, and the payment container started 05:23:14Z. All 5 nodes report Ready=True with MemoryPressure, DiskPressure and PIDPressure=False.

Trace samples show successful requests coexisting with the failures: frontend GET spans at 05:14Z-05:16Z carry http.status_code 200/308 with rpc.grpc.status_code 0, and the proxy logged 200 via_upstream on GET /api/cart and POST /api/cart repeatedly between 05:23:06Z and 05:33:59Z.

The payment rollout cannot explain the alert's onset: the alert starts at 05:22:57Z whereas the new payment ReplicaSet/Scale-up event is at 05:23:10Z, and at 05:22:57Z payment and frontend had zero error spans, so the only non-trivial error series at that instant belonged to frontend-proxy itself.

The reported 0.0111 cannot be recomputed from the returned span series: frontend-proxy ingress error spans are 0 in the minute buckets ending 05:18Z through 05:22Z even though the alert reports a non-zero ratio at 05:22:57Z, so the alert must be computed on a request-level series this Run could not identify.

Pod-level failure (crash, OOMKill, eviction or restart) of frontend or frontend-proxy is rejected: the frontend and frontend-proxy containers show restartCount 0, state running, empty lastState, and no pod events other than the payment rollout events were returned.
Node capacity or pressure as the cause is rejected for the state observed at query time: all 5 nodes are Ready=True with MemoryPressure, DiskPressure and PIDPressure False.

The error type present when the alert fired is the sporadic '503 UC upstream_reset_before_response_started{connection_termination}' series: the frontend HTTP server terminates connections before response headers on GET routes, which Envoy (frontend-proxy) reports as a 503 and which leaves no frontend span. The internal reason inside frontend (for example keep-alive/idle-connection handling or a listener restart) is not verified because the frontend container produced no readable log lines.

The 05:24Z-05:30Z burst is a second, additive contributor caused by the Deployment/payment rolling update: with a single payment replica the old pod stopped at 05:23:15Z while the new payment process only began serving at 05:24:31Z, so checkout's PaymentService/Charge calls failed, frontend returned 500 on /api/checkout and frontend-proxy recorded the 500s and the associated error spans in the same window.

Compare the Envoy upstream cluster 'frontend' idle/keep-alive timeout with the frontend HTTP server's keep-alive settings, and restore frontend container log collection (it currently yields zero bytes) so the connection-termination cause can be confirmed rather than inferred.

Review the Deployment/payment pod-template change made at 05:23:10Z (same image string 2.1.3-payment, new ReplicaSet) and give the single-replica payment workload a rollout strategy that always keeps one serving endpoint (maxUnavailable 0 with surge, an adequate readiness probe, or a PodDisruptionBudget) so checkout does not lose its payment backend for about 76 s.

gaps: The RequestErrorRate alerting rule is not loaded in this Prometheus: list_prometheus_rules returned no rules for rule_name RequestErrorRate and no alerting rules for type=alert, so the expression that produced 0.0111 and its denominator are unknown.

No http_* metric names and no http_server_request_duration_seconds_count series exist in this source (get_metric_names and get_series returned no data), so the alert's request-level error ratio could not be recomputed.

No kube_* metric series exist here (get_metric_names returned no data; kube_deployment_status_replicas_available for payment returned no data), so payment's available-replica count over time could not be charted.

The frontend container produced no log lines for 04:22:57Z-05:46:14Z nor for 05:20:00Z-05:46:14Z (0 bytes, 0 lines read), so the internal reason the frontend terminated proxy connections is unverified.

Jaeger tag searches for error=true and otel.status_code=ERROR on the frontend and on frontend-proxy ingress 500s in the 05:23Z-05:35Z burst window returned no data, so burst-window span detail rests on metrics and the proxy access log rather than span graphs.
Only 5 of the 621 frontend-proxy spans in the window were sampled for traces_search, and the tag-based searches returned no data; the sampled view does not establish a complete call chain.
change_history is not an integrated source and secrets are unreadable, so which pod-template field changed in Deployment/payment at 05:23:10Z is unknown.
The old payment pod payment-55766d76b9-5frt4 was deleted, so its termination reason, exit code and logs are unavailable beyond the 'Killing / Stopping container payment' event.
Events returned by this Run cover only 05:23:10Z-05:23:15Z; an event that was not returned is unknown, not proof that nothing else occurred.
OTel minute buckets may lag real span timestamps, so the alignment of the 78-error bucket ending 05:26:00Z with the 05:23:15Z-05:24:31Z payment gap is approximate.
Small flagd EventStream error counts on ad, recommendation and fraud-detection (about 1-2 spans per hour, present both at 05:22:57Z and 05:36:57Z) were not tied to this alert and remain unexplained.
next_steps: Retrieve the RequestErrorRate rule definition from the Alertmanager/rule source and confirm whether it scores frontend-proxy ingress spans or a separate request metric.
Inspect the frontend (Next.js) server and Envoy keep-alive settings, and confirm whether the frontend listener restarted or closed idle connections around 05:02Z-05:33Z.
Restore frontend log collection and correlate the frontend HTTP server lifecycle with the 503 UC occurrences, for example via node-level packet capture, since container logs are missing.
Audit what changed in the Deployment/payment pod template at 05:23:10Z and whether that single-replica dependency's rollout strategy should be tightened.
